quests.title: Misplaced Creativity

dialogue.t: Where did I go wrong? If only I had more than theoretical knowledge...
Okay, no need to confirm this order... This is Ginette, a Fontainian engineer. Of all the orders I got, this one was the most interesting!
You're finally here! So there's still hope...
Hi there! We're Aino's assistants... Or, well, Paimon thinks you can call us that. Whaddya need help with?

She's made a type of robot that can use kuuvahki to achieve long-distance communication... which sounds super fun! But she's run into a whole bunch of malfunctions, and so she wants me to help her troubleshoot her stuff.
I'm ashamed to admit that trial-and-error curiosity won't yield any results. In the end, it still boils down to practice...
Doesn't sound that hard... Just leave it to us!
This is a bit embarrassing, but... I'd like to modify my order. While waiting for your reply, I... Well, I ended up making another mess of things...
I was suddenly curious if a change of environment could solve the issue. So I conducted more tests in areas with different kuuvahki concentrations.
...But the malfunctions still happened, and I ended up losing those robots. Sooo... apart from the agreed-upon debugging... Could you help me retrieve the robots as well...?
You lost the robots? All of them?
If you need me to compensate with extra pay, I'll think of something, I promise!
Hmm.... But there should be many ways to track them down. Since the robots are all powered by kuuvahki, they should leave behind kuuvahki remnants wherever they go.
I'll prep a special device for you. Once you use it to collect enough kuuvahki remnants, you'll be able to track down whichever robot left 'em behind.
Hmm-hmm... Well, this sounds fun! And since it does, I won't ask for extra pay!

quests.description: Fontainian researcher Ginette has designed a certain type of robot, but has asked Aino for help due to running into various malfunctions…
